title: Pulse Diagnosis in Early Chinese Medicine: The Telling Touch, front matter
lineage: Brief paraphrased notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: Hsu’s preface dates the Shiji to about 86 BCE and identifies the memoir in chapter 105 as an extensive account of pulse diagnosis with 25 medical case histories. This is a conventional date for the history, not the date of a surviving manuscript or proof that transmitted wording is original. Only the front matter and preface were inspected.
